sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx:Quality Checks!A25:D25; Internal Quality Checks!A25:D25; Deterministic Checks!A29:C29,A33:C33
evidence: Parsed scoring.toml and all five judge.toml files with Python tomllib. scoring.toml:1-11 has the expected two zero-weight gates, 0.6/0.2/0.2 scored weights and 0.05 functional floor; all five files have resolvable prompt.md files, browser MCP servers, typed positive-weight criteria, unique ids, and gate all_pass/binary criteria. However functional/judge.toml (SHA256 18fbf6979ef5c92da5930b1638f7ad26dfe4f839e4ff27bea011286ebab2e286) has only one [[judge.mcp_servers]] block at lines 8-12, named playwright; parsed server names are ['playwright']. Its cw_save_reload_restart criterion at lines 198-203 requires the verifier-provided restart_app tool. test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER and tools/restart_mcp.py defines restart_app, but the functional judge never declares the verifier MCP server or passes the helper argument. The frozen template's functional/judge.toml:14-18 shows the missing verifier block with args ['/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py', '$APP_RESTART_HELPER']. This is a static structural finding, not a measured full judge run. The referenced raw-evidence-index.json was absent at review time, so no runtime result or artifact hashes from it were used.
counterexample: A fully conforming app that persists the saved revision through a server restart cannot have that behavior observed by the functional judge, because restart_app is unavailable to it. An app that survives only a page reload but loses data on process restart can look identical during the available browser-only part; scoring either app on the missing restart observation would misgrade it.
suggested_fix: Restore the template's verifier MCP server block in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml, using /usr/local/bin/python3 with args ['/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py', '$APP_RESTART_HELPER'], then validate the structure and rerun the full configured judge on the changed candidate.
